verdict_reason: Query-string, href and role-search helpers are correct and tested; one Major naming finding: roleLabelsOf/roleLabels return a joined string, not labels.

todos.issue: roleLabelsOf (line 45) and the row key roleLabels (line 67) have a plural value word, so a reader expects an array of labels. Both actually hold one comma-joined string ('Place of origin, Consignor') that the controller puts straight into a table cell as { text: address.roleLabels } (list.controller.js:52).
todos.fix: Must: the function and the row key say they hold one piece of display text, the role labels joined. One way: rename them to roleLabelsText / roleLabelsText (or typeColumnText), and update list.controller.js:52 and the test titles and expectations in list.test.js to match.
